run_pipeline_parallel_benchmark: run the experimental async pipeline parallel language model benchmark with MPI and specified decoder layers
create_spectrain_sgd_optimizer: create a SpectrainSGDMomentum optimizer that uses weight prediction with momentum for pipeline parallel training
create_xpipe_adam_optimizer: create an XpipeAdam optimizer that uses future weight prediction based on microbatch index for pipeline parallel training
build_transformer_lm_model: build a TransformerLMSequntial language model with embedding, positional encoding, decoder, and linear layers for pipe compatibility
generate_pipeline_balance: generate a balanced layer distribution across pipeline parallel devices using generate_balance or generate_balance_weighted
